title: Ceramic Stash Jar – Pineapple
description: This tropical-themed ceramic stash jar is made in the shape of a pineapple with a green leafy top. The jar has a tight-seal cork that keeps sensitive materials like herbs, spices, medicine, coffee, tea, and so on fresh and sealed for months.
